title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff/ordering hysteresis to prevent regional failover thrashing
author: Samantha Lee
release_notes: Hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer hysteresis and ordering to prevent cascade regional failovers and reduce backoff thrashing under sudden traffic spikes.
description: Motivation: Under high transient traffic spikes we observed repeated regional failovers driven by the SLO enforcer oscillating between backoff and failover decisions. The root cause was a combination of (1) a suboptimal ordering heuristic that let less-stable regions be selected during simultaneous candidate evaluation and (2) insufficient hysteresis on backoff counters so brief transient errors triggered aggressive failover. This PR introduces tightened hysteresis, a deterministic ordering tie-breaker favoring historically-stable regions, and a small debounce window when evaluating backoff thresholds. Changes are conservative: defaults preserve current behavior but enable safer failover under noisy signals. Includes unit and integration tests, CI flake retries, and rollout guidance.

patch_highlights: ordering.go: introduce RegionStabilityScore(weightedDataEviction, recentSuccessRate) and deterministic tie-breaker using region ID hash
backoff.go: add hysteresis counter (require N consecutive decisions before escalating) and 500ms debounce window when updating candidate state
integration test: simulate 60s spike with interleaved success/failure to assert no >1 failover per 60s under noise

rollback_plan: If we observe regression in production canary (increased latency or missed failovers) rollback by reverting this commit and reapplying previous backoff thresholds. We've instrumented metrics: slo_enforcer.hysteresis_transition and slo_enforcer.region_stability_score to monitor. A feature flag (slo_enforcer.ordered_stable_regions) can be toggled for instant rollback without redeploy.
observability_notes: Emits new metrics: slo_enforcer.hysteresis_transition (counter), slo_enforcer.region_stability_score (gauge per-region). Added logs at INFO when backoff escalation occurs. Dashboard update PR queued.
rollout_plan: Merge to main, canary deploy to us-west-2 (10% traffic) for 2 hours, monitor hysteresis_transition and failover rate; expand to 50% for 6 hours if stable, full rollout after 24h. Ops on-call notified via Slack #sre-incidents.
